selection_rationale: Figure 3b reports experimental relative fluorescence contrast over many pulse counts for conventional XY8, with complete eight-pulse blocks and a visible high-depth loss. The short-free-evolution condition deliberately isolates accumulated control errors from bath decoherence. This directly tests an XY8-specific mechanism represented only approximately by the project's scalar per-pulse survival factor.
independence_statement: Farfurnik et al. (2015) was not used to select any explicit parameter in the project's Table 1 scenario files. The dataset, digitization rules, observable, and parameter treatment were frozen before evaluating the current model. No model parameter will be fitted to the measured curve.

source.citation: D. Farfurnik et al., Optimizing a dynamical decoupling protocol for solid-state electronic spin ensembles in diamond, Physical Review B 92, 060301(R) (2015).
source.panel_content: experimental relative contrast in the short-free-evolution limit

reported_hardware.sample_description: approximately 10^4 NV centres in a 25 cubic micrometre measurement volume
reported_hardware.error_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian samples held fixed for each simulated NV centre and complete pulse sequence

observable_and_scope.measured_observable: relative fluorescence contrast normalized to a one-pulse Hahn echo in the same short-free-evolution limit
observable_and_scope.validation_target: depth-dependent loss from accumulated XY8 control errors

predeclared_comparison.project_prediction: raw pulse survival is F_pi^(8*N); comparison to the paper's one-pulse Hahn-echo normalization is F_pi^(8*N-1)
predeclared_comparison.no_fit_statement: Neither the nominal fidelity, the fidelity range, nor the pulse-count axis is fitted to the measured XY8 contrast curve.
predeclared_comparison.normalization: the experimental curve retains the paper's Hahn-echo normalization; the scalar prediction starts at one at zero pulses
primary_checks: correct direction of change with depth
pulse count at which relative contrast first falls below 0.5

predeclared_coherent_comparison.model: instantaneous conventional-XY8 propagator with quasi-static coherent angle and rotation-axis errors
predeclared_coherent_comparison.normalization_reference: one imperfect X-axis pi pulse representing the reported Hahn-echo normalization
predeclared_coherent_comparison.quasi_static_scope: one draw per NV centre, held fixed for all pulses in that sequence
predeclared_coherent_comparison.sampling_method: seeded Monte Carlo with common standard-normal draws for every uncertainty case
predeclared_coherent_comparison.sampling_rationale: The source simulation averages 10000 NV centres. Seed 150500636 is fixed from the paper's arXiv identifier 1505.00636 and is unrelated to the measured contrast values. Preliminary numerical QA rejected low-order Gaussian quadrature because it was not converged at N=73; no physical parameter was changed.
predeclared_coherent_comparison.uncertainty_range_rule: multiply all three reported approximate standard deviations independently by 0.75, 1.00, or 1.25 and use the pointwise envelope of the resulting 27 predeclared combinations
predeclared_coherent_comparison.uncertainty_range_rationale: The supplement reports approximate error scales but no parameter confidence intervals; a symmetric plus-or-minus 25 percent sensitivity range was declared before coherent evaluation and is not fitted to the contrast points.
predeclared_coherent_comparison.no_fit_statement: No coherent error magnitude, distribution weight, normalization, pulse depth, or uncertainty range is adjusted after comparison with the three experimental XY8 points.

source_provenance.effective_axis_error_treatment: The paper states that the physical detuning mixture gives behavior similar to a zero-mean Gaussian nz distribution with standard deviation approximately 0.06; the latter is used to match its Eq. 1 pulse-error abstraction without double-counting detuning.

digitization_protocol.source_asset: author-supplied fig3b.eps from the arXiv source archive
digitization_protocol.x_coordinate: total pi-pulse count n; retain multiples of eight and convert to XY8 block count N=n/8
digitization_protocol.point_rule: digitize marker centres; do not digitize connecting line segments
digitization_protocol.uncertainty_rule: the source panel provides no error bars; do not invent them
digitization_protocol.precision_rule: retain two decimal places for contrast and exact integer pulse counts
digitization_protocol.error_bar_rule: digitize upper and lower cap positions separately; preserve asymmetry if visible
digitization_protocol.model_blinding: digitization and all corrections are completed before the current model is evaluated
